permutationLabel: Post-endoscopy: duodenal ulcer Forrest IIa treated endoscopically — complete Rockall 6
summary: 66-year-old man with ischaemic heart disease after OGD: duodenal ulcer with a non-bleeding visible vessel (Forrest IIa) treated with adrenaline and clips. Complete Rockall 6. High-dose PPI for 72 h, H. pylori testing, no routine second-look.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Review after endoscopy for black stools
inputs.hpi: Admitted overnight with melaena. OGD this morning: 12 mm posterior duodenal bulb ulcer with a non-bleeding visible vessel (Forrest IIa), treated with adrenaline injection and two haemoclips. Rapid urease test taken. Known ischaemic heart disease (angina). Not on antiplatelets.

imaging.name: OGD
imaging.result: Posterior duodenal bulb ulcer 12 mm with a non-bleeding visible vessel (Forrest IIa). Adrenaline 1:10,000 injection and two haemoclips — haemostasis achieved. Rapid urease test taken. No varices.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Bleeding duodenal ulcer, Forrest IIa, endoscopic haemostasis
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Duodenal ulcer bleed — Forrest IIa non-bleeding visible vessel, endoscopic haemostasis with adrenaline and clips. Complete Rockall 6 (age 1, IHD 2, diagnosis 1, stigmata 2).

recommended.note: Post-endoscopy, the complete Rockall score is the relevant score (web suggests the pre-endoscopy Rockall key).

mustInclude.note: Test at index endoscopy; repeat if negative in the acute setting.
High-dose PPI for 72 h after endoscopic haemostasis of a high-risk ulcer reduces rebleeding.

mustExclude.note: ESGE: routine second-look endoscopy is not recommended.

guideline.name: ESGE Guideline — endoscopic diagnosis and management of nonvariceal upper gastrointestinal haemorrhage (NVUGIH), update 2021
guideline.section: High-dose PPI (e.g. 80 mg IV bolus then 8 mg/h, or intermittent bolus) for 72 h after endoscopic haemostasis; Forrest classification of stigmata; no routine second-look endoscopy; H. pylori testing and eradication
guideline.citation: Gralnek IM, Stanley AJ, Morris AJ, et al. Endoscopy. 2021;53:300–332.

guideline.name: NICE CG141 — Acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding in over 16s: management
guideline.section: Complete Rockall score after endoscopy; PPI after endoscopy to patients with stigmata of recent haemorrhage
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Clinical guideline CG141. London: NICE; 2012 (last updated 2016).

guideline.name: Rockall score — derivation
guideline.section: Complete score adds diagnosis (all diagnoses other than Mallory-Weiss/no lesion → 1; malignancy → 2) and stigmata (visible vessel → 2)
guideline.citation: Rockall TA, Logan RF, Devlin HB, Northfield TC. Risk assessment after acute upper gastrointestinal haemorrhage. Gut. 1996;38:316–321.

guideline.name: Maastricht VI/Florence consensus report — management of Helicobacter pylori infection
guideline.section: H. pylori eradication in bleeding peptic ulcer; confirm eradication
guideline.citation: Malfertheiner P, Megraud F, Rokkas T, et al. Gut. 2022;71:1724–1762.

guideline.name: HALT-IT randomised trial — tranexamic acid in gastrointestinal bleeding
guideline.section: Tranexamic acid: no benefit, more venous thromboembolism
guideline.citation: HALT-IT Trial Collaborators. Effects of a high-dose 24-h infusion of tranexamic acid on death and thromboembolic events in patients with acute gastrointestinal bleeding (HALT-IT). Lancet. 2020;395:1927–1936.

rationale: Post-endoscopy stage of the non-variceal bleed. The complete Rockall score and the Forrest class drive the post-endoscopy plan: 72 h high-dose PPI, H. pylori test-and-treat, and no routine second look.
